fullContentHtml:
Oriental Insurance OICL AO 2025 Score Card & Marks - Complete Details

The Oriental Insurance Company Limited (OICL) has announced the Score Card and Marks for the recruitment of 300 Administrative Officers (Scale-I) (Generalists & Specialists) 2025. Candidates can view their marks and selection status online.

Important Dates

  • Online Application Period : March - April 2025
  • Phase I Prelims Exam : July 2025
  • Phase II Mains Exam : September 2025
  • Score Card Declared : 19 September 2026

Important Links

  • Download OICL AO Score Card
  • OICL Official Website
